prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Keyword Researcher Needed - Ongoing
Need someone to do keyword research regularly - Ongoing. I'll give you an industry or business type - and you tell me the best keywords / search terms for that industry etc... 1) Please tell me what experience you have 2) Please list all tools you currently have an active account for, and have access to 3) List any strengths you have And if you want to provide screenshots or something to help show your abilities, go ahead. Thank you!
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need someone who can take an industry or business type and turn it into strong, relevant keywords and search terms on an ongoing basis.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, and data visualization, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. I’m comfortable organizing large sets of information, identifying patterns, and turning raw data into clear, useful outputs.

Tools I currently have active access to: SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

My strengths are analytical thinking, attention to detail, and building clean, well-structured keyword lists that are easy to review and use. I can also present findings in a dashboard or spreadsheet format if helpful.

If you'd like, I can share screenshots or sample layouts to show how I work.
